item.title: Collision rating for 12/17/2025
item.description: The one-hour Collision which aired immediately following Dynamite on Wednesday night had 333,000 viewers. Last week’s number was never published, although that show aired in the afternoon on Saturday to avoid SNME competition. Collision had a 0.05 rating in 18-49.
